scripts.name: Server
scripts.command: cd apps/server && go build -tags sqlite_fts5 -o bin/recall ./cmd/recall && set -a && { [ ! -f ../app/.env ] || . ../app/.env; } && set +a && DATA_DIR=../app/data bin/recall serve

scripts.name: Test
scripts.command: cd apps/server && go test -tags sqlite_fts5 ./... && cd ../app && npx vitest run

scripts.name: Typecheck
scripts.command: cd apps/server && go vet -tags sqlite_fts5 ./... && cd ../app && npx tsc --noEmit
